conventions: cycles = 833 ps stream edges from the edge sampling the record go (unit face) to the edge sampling done (IDX/ARGMAX) or from the compiler issue_at slot to mv_done (DMA back). Unit work only: the model adds dispatch wire (IDX 17 / ARGMAX 5 edges) and other terms outside the unit. "bound" = parameters exactly as GEN2e3 die.v binds them (rootctl_am VM_RT 0 / CR_RT 0, argmax r2 VMX 5 / ACK 13, dbk RR_RT 7) on the VM contract those parameters state; "*_banklat_budget" = the HBM-BANKLAT GEN2c budget parameters with padded die lanes (rootctl_am 65/36, argmax VMX 77 / ACK 52 + lanes 4/3, dbk RR_RT 80 + NE lanes). The die as built has faces pin banks + relay lanes, so the bound parameters are LAT-FAIL there (HBM-BANKLAT); the budget numbers are what a functional die with those lanes costs.
